name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week's setup is more flush than flourish: 44 mm of rain and only one hot day mean the lake is being stirred and diluted rather than baking into a calm, stable soup, even though early-July warmth at 27.7C keeps a bloom from being off the table.
evidence: Rain total of 44.0 mm is heavy enough to mix and flush the water column
Only 1 hot day (above 30C) this week, so no sustained heat run
Average max temp of 27.7C is warm but below the 30C bloom-favouring threshold
